crossRefs.note: When they came near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
“Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

Then the disciples came, and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”
Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these…
They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
“Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know…
Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…

people.name: Olives_Mount
people.line: A mountain ridge east of Jerusalem

translations.web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
translations.bsb: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
translations.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
translations.asv: And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
